entry.name: CS224n: NLP with Deep Learning
entry.note: The NLP counterpart to CS231n, updated through the transformer era

reading.cost: The page states a medium fee for XCS224N and high cost for CS224N via Stanford, without exact amounts.
covers: large language model benchmarking and evaluation
reading.format: Lectures are held in person and livestreamed. Enrolled students can access lecture videos on Canvas. Assessment includes four assignments with written and programming parts and a final project, either default or custom.
reading.summary: This Stanford course introduces natural language processing with deep learning. It covers foundational neural network methods for NLP and recent research on large language models. Through lectures, assignments, and a final project, students learn to design, implement, and understand neural network models using PyTorch.
reading.audience: Stanford students can enroll in CS224N, and others can enroll through Stanford or the XCS224N professional program version.
reading.prerequisites: All assignments use Python and NumPy. The page lists college calculus, linear algebra, basic probability and statistics, and foundations of machine learning as prerequisites. Prior deep learning knowledge is helpful but not required.
